parsed.answer: The five most influential papers on Parkinson's disease and alpha-synuclein, ranked by citation count, cover key themes: neuropathological staging of Lewy body pathology, causative alpha-synuclein mutations (E46K), fibril formation kinetics, in vivo toxicity of oligomers, and mitochondrial dysfunction. The landmark Braak staging paper (2003) is by far the most cited, establishing the six-stage progression of alpha-synuclein/Lewy pathology in sporadic Parkinson's disease.
